derivation: exact Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.continuous_det (n := Fin 2) (R := HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ p)
explanation: Mathlib's `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.continuous_det` (`Continuous (det : GL n R → Rˣ)`) holds for any `[Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [CommRing R] [TopologicalSpace R] [IsTopologicalRing R]`. The target is the instance `n := Fin 2`, `R := HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion ℚ p`, whose `CommRing` (indeed `Field`) structure comes from `RingTheory/DedekindDomain/AdicValuation.lean` and whose `IsTopologicalRing` instance is the priority-100 instance derived from `Valued (adicCompletion K v) ℤᵐ⁰` (`Topology/Algebra/Valued/ValuationTopology.lean`). The library proof instead reproves it via `Units.continuous_iff` and continuity of matrix determinant, essentially mirroring Mathlib's own proof.
